geometry.operand_dtypes: q,k,v,a,b bf16; A_log, dt_bias, S0 fp32; state fp32

numerics.note: M1 comparator: q1_2b_fixtures.c2_node_refs (float64 C2, one cast of the recorded bf16/fp32 operands) + q1_oracle.per_head_errors; reported next to the time; NOT a pass/fail gate

step.note: steady state: the in-kernel commit of the previous accepted leaf is active

verify_only_sentinel.note: positive gcum sentinel set before each iteration (untimed): commit skipped

graph.commit_estimate_note: derived: steady fused step minus sentinel (commit-skipped) step; not separately measurable

eager.commit_estimate_note: derived: steady fused step minus sentinel (commit-skipped) step; not separately measurable

stashes_allocated.note: vt [Hv,N,V], kk [N,Hv,K], gc [Hv,N] fp32 per layer per slot: the deferred-commit factors

dfs_staging_and_remap.note: M1 physical->DFS operand staging + inverse-remapped output (charged gather/remap)

accounting.per_call_allocations: out [1,N,Hv,V] bf16 per layer call (captured by peak allocated)

memory.note: torch caching-allocator statistics (GB10 unified memory); peaks reset per experiment; graph pools count as allocated

deployment_mode.step: one fused call per layer = commit(previous accepted leaf) + verify(this tree); graph mode = decode CUDA graph (vLLM fork)
deployment_mode.commit: not separable: fused into the next verify; estimated as step - verify_only (sentinel) and reported as derived
deployment_mode.flush: final deferred flush = one extra fused call per layer (finite-session overhead)

timing_protocol.clock: torch.cuda.Event pairs on the current stream
timing_protocol.state_reset: durable state reset to S0 before each experiment (not between iterations)
timing_protocol.accepted_paths: 28 Hydra27 accepted paths cycled per iteration from a device table (D2D copy inside the commit region)
